# The plug-ins

audioairwindows carries 528 of Airwindows' 529 plug-ins, each a class of the same name. A desktop install has every one; a board build has the 140 marked **board** unless you choose others ([Install](../get-started/install.md#choose-the-plug-ins)). They are grouped here by upstream's categories, and every parameter is the plug-in's own 0 to 1 knob, as its keyword argument.

[Not carried](#not-carried) lists the 1 left out, and why. [Accuracy](accuracy.md) has each one's measured error against upstream.

## Full precision on boards

On a part whose FPU has no double, such as the ESP32-S3, each plug-in runs a single-precision copy of its loop, held to the same bar against upstream as the full-precision one. These 255, marked **ref** above, drift outside that bar in single precision, so a board runs upstream's arithmetic for them instead: the same sound, at a higher cost in time. The figure is how far the single-precision loop strayed, in int16 steps.

## Not carried

| Plug-in | Why |
|---|---|
| DitherFloat | a demonstration of upstream's dither for 32-bit float output; this module's output is 16-bit, and that dither is the step every port leaves out |
